name: B10-0246/2025 – After recital E – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text: E. whereas the green and digital transitions require an update to single market rules in order to set the right conditions to achieve a fairer, more sustainable and digitally fit EU; whereas regulatory tools must be aligned with those policy objectives; whereas single market rules to boost competitiveness must not come at the expense of safe and good-quality jobs within the EU;
